links.outcome: Multiple-choice accuracy on cardiology board questions with versus without RAG over guideline and textbook documents
links.effect: All 14 models improved after RAG; open-weight Mistral Large 2 reached 78.0% (95% CI 73.9-81.5), comparable to GPT 4o. RAG was particularly beneficial for smaller models.
links.quote: After RAG, all models improved, and open-weight models like Mistral Large 2 (78.0%, 95% CI: 73.9-81.5) performed comparably to proprietary alternatives like GPT 4o.

unlisted_practices: Considering open-weight models as lower-cost, locally deployable alternatives to proprietary LLMs

screen.practice: retrieval grounding (RAG) with guideline and textbook knowledge base
screen.reason: The study directly evaluates the impact of adding retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) to existing open-weight and proprietary LLMs on cardiovascular exam benchmarks.
